headline: Bank of Japan Issues Report on October Current Account Balances, Operations
summary: The Bank of Japan released its monthly report on the sources of changes in current account balances and market operations for October.
why: The Bank of Japan's current account data reflects commercial banking liquidity and central bank market operations, providing insight into reserve balances and money-market conditions.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen money market liquidity
impacts.why: The report outlines reserve balances and liquidity movements managed through the central bank's market operations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
